name: research-funnel
description: Orchestrates validated research skills (fasttrack-topic-validator, paper-search, research-litnote, paper-compare, decision-matrix, related-work, academic-document-writer, paper-critique, citation-check, llm-council) into a full research funnel from idea to publication, with a human decision gate at every stage: idea, gap check, reading, study design, experiments, venue choice, drafting, pre-submission review, and reviewer response.
